payload.reason: The evidence indicates that post-editing rates were chosen over prediction (h)ter for intrinsic uncertainty evaluation because post-editing time captures both technical and cognitive effort, making it a more comprehensive measure of post-editing effort. Additionally, it is more applicable in real translation environments, directly relating to productivity measures.

claims.text: Post-editing time is a more complete measure of post-editing effort than HTER, capturing both technical and cognitive aspects.
Post-editing rates are directly applicable in real translation environments, relating to productivity measures.
Using post-editing rates allows for better decision-making in translation workflows compared to point estimates.
